rationale: This study conducts a technical GIS and hierarchical site-selection feasibility analysis for constructing underground dams in streambeds based on geology, hydrology, topography, and stream geometry. It focuses exclusively on physical/engineering water-storage siting (E06) and does not examine household or community water/sanitation service access or any legal, regulatory, or administrative mechanism.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Excluded under both narrow and plain readings of Criterion 2 because the study is purely a physical/hydrogeological GIS engineering site-selection study with no legal, administrative, institutional, or governance dimension and no household water/sanitation service access outcome.

evidence_quotes.quote: This study assesses the feasibility of constructing underground dams in the western sub-basins of Semnan Province using a hierarchical analysis approach within a Geographic Information System (GIS).
To identify suitable locations for these structures, key factors such as geology, hydrology, water resources, topography, and stream geometry were analyzed.
